hypothesis: When an unauthenticated visitor opens the root URL with an unregistered or stale user_uuid in localStorage, ensureValidSession() receives HTTP 401 from /api/auth/session and blindly triggers triggerReauthPrompt(detail). SessionReauthModal unconditionally opens over LandingPage, presenting an alarming re-authentication modal for an account that does not exist, blocking visitor onboarding and locking the visitor in a 10s cooldown deadlock.

LandingPage.handleLogin() generates a rogue client-side UUID via generateUUID() and writes it to localStorage without verifying its registration in the Supabase database. On subsequent page visits, ensureValidSession() treats this unregistered UUID as a legacy recovery key, which fails legacy_identity_exists on the backend, inducing HTTP 401 and permanently triggering the SessionReauthModal trap on refresh.

If handleLogin() strictly depends on ensureValidSession() without an offline fallback, an unauthenticated user on their first visit without internet (navigator.onLine === false) will receive null from ensureValidSession(), causing the Start Journey action to fail silently and breaking Tabiji's L0 offline-first architectural invariant.
